But the madness doesn't stop there. Once Bronny arrives, LeBron drops the ultimate bombshell: benching All-NBA superstar Tyrese Maxey so Bronny can start at point guard as the franchise player... while LeBron snatches Luka's recovery chocolate chip cookies for himself! 🍪🔥 Watch as Jaylen Brown rages over being traded five minutes after signing, Rob Pelinka panics, Luka Dončić defends his beer stash, and Tyrese Maxey completely crashes out after losing his starting spot to nepotism! Is this the ultimate LeGM masterclass or did LeBron just destroy the Philadelphia 76ers from the inside out?
